response.rationale: Option A (Eosinophilic annular erythema) is ranked first because it is a subtype of the top-ranked leaf 'Eosinophilic dermatitis related to immunotherapy' and has the highest confidence score (0.9) among the matched options. Among B and D, the order is arbitrary as their confidence scores are equal. Option C (Granuloma annulare) is ranked last because it is unrelated to the top-ranked leaf.
